review.imagery: Eleven native brochure project renders were visually reviewed. The 4970-pixel original South Haven exterior supplies the card and hero. Other views cover three exterior angles, living room, two bedroom views, pool, recreation and gym. Generic people photographs and duplicate current-gallery scenes are excluded. Some published interior concepts also appear in South Haven 2 material. Final unit-specific fitout remains unverified. No dated construction photography or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Five home drawings and eight floorplate/amenity sheets retain their complete source pages. Numerical unit areas are absent. Some floorplate tables retain the name Hills South 4 beneath South Haven branding. Confirm the applicable approved drawing and contractual size with SAMANA. All 13 complete physical plan-pack sheets 5–12 and 14–18 were individually reviewed. First-floor and roof amenity sheets are separate from the six residence floorplates. The visible floorplate tables retain Hills South 4, while the main drawings and cover say South Haven. This is disclosed as a source naming difference, without assuming a separate protected project identity. The brochure repeats these sheets. Primary 354 versus microsite 355.85 sq ft minimums are not assigned to a particular drawing.
review.location: The complete original brochure page 9 was visually reviewed. Six brochure destinations have 15–20 minute estimates, with Jebel Ali added by the current primary page. The official embed publishes 24.869799214853003, 55.03996827116446. Its full value, source hash and six-place conversion are retained. The primary microsite’s Plot 50 / municipality 531-409 address anchors Dubai Industrial City, distinct from wider Dubai South marketing.
review.provenance: Fresh primary and microsite HTML, original developer brochure, official plan pack and factbook retain retrieval receipts, bytes and SHA-256 values. Original image resources, complete drawing notices and individual physical-page links remain available. Protected identity, completed commercial/text research and source differences are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, the contractual explanation of inherited floorplate table naming, final unit fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
